surfaces.name: tlbx host (mt, mthost, mtagenthost; Windows, macOS, Linux)
Browser UI and installable PWA (desktop, tablet, phone)
tlbx mobile connection app (iOS and Android WebView manager)
Native tlbx MCP server and generated mt helpers

claims.answer: Self-hosted host on Windows (x64/x86), macOS (x64/arm64) and Linux (x64/arm64) with a browser UI for desktop, tablet and phone (installable PWA). The repository holds the source of a native iOS/Android connection-manager app (WebView) with a manual store-publication handoff, but no store listing or release binary is documented; no native desktop client or editor extension.

scope.version: v11.1.8 stable (commit 1e448c4, released 2026-11-13); dev channel v11.2.x not scoped
scope.plan: Open source (AGPL-3.0, commercial licence offered); free

desktop_os.answer: Release builds target Windows x64/x86, macOS x64/arm64 and Linux x64/arm64; the product is a host service used through a browser, not a native desktop UI.

mobile_apps.answer: Source for `ai.tlbx.app`, a WebView connection manager for iOS/iPadOS 16+ and Android 8+, exists in src/connectors; STORE_SETUP.md describes a manual store-publication handoff, the stable release attaches no mobile binary and the README does not mention the app, so public availability is not established. The workspace itself is the web UI.

browser.answer: Full workspace in any browser: sessions, files, Git, previews, History.

mobile_browser.answer: Responsive phone/tablet UI, installable PWA, on-screen-keyboard handling and touch special keys.

cli.answer: Generated `mt` helpers and `mt mcp --stdio`; the Bash/PowerShell helpers are deprecated in favour of MCP; `mt` also launches the host.

editor_extensions.answer: No editor extension in a bounded search; a Chrome Mobile Device Bridge extension exists for device emulation only.

task_actions.answer: Start sessions, send prompts and keys, queue follow-ups, approve agent requests (Allow), interrupt, upload files, review Git diffs and resume from another browser.

notifications.answer: Attention requests and exact browser notifications from control-plane events; no push service documented for stable.

cross_device_continuity.answer: Reconnect to the same sessions from another browser; several authorized browsers can observe and control one host.

limitations: Not fully established or not supported: mobile_apps, cli, editor_extensions, notifications; see atomic answers.
